text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to pick streaming defaults for chat/completions for the next milestone. Customers care about resumability, clear finish reasons, and mobile battery/latency. SSE vs WS? Delta format? finishReason enums?
Liam: My take: default to SSE for hosted API (CDN/proxy friendly) + explicit WS option for multiplexing/bidirectional.
Anya: Mobile perspective: WS reduces connection churn and can multiplex multiple chats in one socket — better for battery and flaky networks. But SDK surface area grows.
Marcus: On finish reasons we should be explicit. Proposal: STOP | LENGTH | USER_CANCEL | TIMEOUT | INTERNAL_ERROR. Also surface a `partial` boolean for truncated/streamed JSON to force client parsing strategies.
Priya: Delta format tradeoffs: simple text deltas (token diffs) vs structured ops (json-patch). Structured ops are clearer for partial structured-output use cases but heavier. Thoughts?
Liam: Recommend a hybrid: primary `delta.text` for tokens + optional `delta.ops` for structured output or rerank metadata. Keep token stream as canonical for backwards compat.
Anya: SDK impact: we need consistent events: onDelta, onFinish(reason, metadata), onResume(tokenIndex, kvState). Define semantics for resume: only allowed if server kept KV cache and model variant matches.
Priya: Launch criteria (draft):
- API: SSE default + optional WS documented
- FinishReason enum published + DTO in SDKs
- Delta schema v1 (text + optional ops) + examples
- Resume contract and fallback rules documented
- Telemetry: per-request latency, resume rate, finishReason counts
- Canary: 3 pilot customers + internal apps
Liam: Backwards compatibility note: SDKs must accept both plain token events and extended delta with ops. Add `compatMode: "legacy"|"v1"` in SDK constructor.
Marcus: Also add test harness: a replay tool that verifies finishReason stability across model versions and quantization profiles.
Priya: Prioritization: must-have = finishReason enum, delta.text, SSE default, SDK parsing hooks. Nice-to-have = full json-patch ops in v1 (opt-in), websocket multiplexing in GA v2.
Anya: Risk: proxies may buffer SSE chunked responses. We should add guidance and sample Nginx/Cloudflare configs to docs.
Priya: Action items: @Liam draft API contract for delta v1 and finishReason enums by EOD Thursday; @Anya stub SDK event names and compatMode by next Tue; @Marcus spec replay tests and telemetry counters. I'll coordinate pilot customers.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline created for streaming-v1 -> env=staging -> 10% traffic staged.
Liam: Ack. I'll post a minimal example payload for delta v1 once done.
Priya: Thanks team — we'll review in the async doc next week and flag any blockers for the roadmap review. :thumbsup:
